skill_yaml:
skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
phases:
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: force_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - -0.05
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
- id: push_1
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: contact_detected
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.21
      axis: world_y
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
    tolerance: 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
